title: Contraction and resonance smoothing over 20 recorded passes
caption: All points are saved states; pass 0 metrics are newly calculated, while passes 1–20 reproduce the original aggregate CSV. Panel D excludes the initialization V=0 to avoid presenting its first step as spontaneous acceleration of retained momentum. No physical-energy units are implied.

title: The same 50 points, viewed on fixed coordinate scales
caption: Orthographic XY/XZ projections at passes 0, 10 and 20. Color uses the fixed resonance scale 0–0.1 (dark purple to yellow); gray segments connect consecutive recorded samples and do not reveal motion between passes. Projection overlap does not imply 3D coincidence. No wrapping or per-panel rescaling is used.

title: Stable rank, continued movement, and close pairs
caption: Rank is an observer, not leadership or a force. Final top-three IDs 38, 23, 8 have pair distances 0.0340–0.0677 at pass 20, still distinct. The first echo pair is 5/43, not the highest-resonance glyph. Echo counts do not drive the update.

title: Smoothing does not make the neighbor graph one connected group
caption: A: algebraic terms read each stored incoming state independently; no output advances a trajectory. Residual contains the unsaved random increment and numerical/provenance uncertainty. D: newly introduced graph diagnostics; weak ignores edge direction, strong requires directed reachability. Global fusion still couples all points even when this local graph splits. Graph at pass 20 is diagnostic only; no pass-21 transition is present.
